item.title: 用于高效神经网络输入掩蔽预处理的可重构铁电结型场效应晶体管
item.description:
📚 Wiley
👤 Tianjiao Zhang, Xinyi Xu, Xiangwei Su, Zhongkai Wang, Yiqi Chen, Yuyang Wu, Chuan Qin, Cheng Zhang, Maoxin Tian, Baoshi Qiao, Xinlong Zeng, Zhixiang Zhang, Huan Hu, Renchao Che, Yang Xu, Yuda Zhao
该工作关注可重构铁电结型场效应晶体管在高效神经网络输入掩蔽预处理中的应用。题名显示其可能面向神经形态或硬件加速预处理功能，但具体器件设计、工作机制和系统性能需查阅原文。

item.title: 从低聚物到缠结聚合物：如何训练可迁移的机器学习原子间势
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Mirko Fischer, Andreas Heuer
本文以聚乙烯为模型，研究面向聚合物的机器学习原子间势构建方法。作者比较多种局域原子描述符，发现原子簇展开（ACE）最适合，并通过自动化主动学习生成训练数据，证明在小低聚物上拟合的 ACE 势可迁移到更大聚合物。与 OPLS-AA 参考势的纳秒级分子动力学对比表明，该势能准确再现关键热力学、结构和动力学性质。

item.title: 用于在能量守恒条件下求解分子动力学运动方程的分子物理信息神经网络（mPINN）
item.description:
📚 Machine Learning: Science and Technology
👤 Temoor Muther, Vuong Van Pham and Amirmasoud Kalantari Dahaghi
本文提出分子物理信息神经网络（mPINN）框架，用于在不依赖先验观测时间序列数据的情况下求解多体原子相互作用的牛顿运动方程。该方法将分子动力学的控制物理规律直接嵌入神经网络训练过程，以增强物理一致性并保持守恒热力学量。与传统逐步离散积分的分子动力学引擎不同，mPINN 在连续时间框架下运行，可缓解时间步选择和稳定性问题，并实现高保真轨迹预测。

item.title: MDcraft——一款支持机器学习势的现代分子动力学模拟软件包
item.description:
📚 ScienceDirect
该条目给出的摘要仅包含出版信息，未提供具体研究内容。根据题目可知，MDcraft 是一款面向现代分子动力学模拟的软件包，并支持机器学习势函数，更多技术细节需查阅原文。

item.title: 用于 4D-STEM 稀疏应变场重建的物理信息神经网络
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Roberto dos Reis, Gabriel T. dos Santos, Yukun Liu, Xiaobing Hu, Vinayak P. Dravid
本文提出一种用于稀疏 4D-STEM 应变重建的物理信息神经网络，将弹性平衡和 Saint-Venant 相容性通过自动微分嵌入损失函数。实验 PbGeSnSe₁.₅Te₁.₅ 应变图测试表明，该方法在低采样率下能较好恢复雪佛龙状应变带，并优于压缩感知和高斯过程回归。消融和不确定性分析显示，PDE 先验在极端稀疏数据下提升精度与物理自洽性，但数据充足时可能引入偏差。

item.title: 面向极端环境低碳能源应用的混合 HiPIMS/脉冲直流 PVD 工艺中机器学习辅助复杂合金与高熵合金设计
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Paul Foulquier, Ryma Haddad, Ali Mahmoud, Eric Monsifrot, Fanny Balbaud-Celerier, Jean-Philippe Poli, Frederic Schuster
本文介绍利用人工智能和混合 HiPIMS/脉冲直流 PVD 工艺设计复杂合金与高熵合金涂层，以服务核能、高温电解等低碳能源极端环境应用。作者概述了法国 DIADEM 材料与数据科学融合计划及其 DIADEM-2D 组合沉积平台，并基于文献数据与沉积参数—涂层性质模型进行耐腐蚀保护涂层设计。研究展示了该工艺的可行性和精度。

item.title: Adaptive Quantum Physics-Informed Neural Networks for Differential Equations with Applications to Fluid Dynamics
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Fabio Pereira dos Santos, Renato Portugal, Júlio de Castro Vargas Fernandes, Lucas Timotheo Sanches
arXiv:2608.00850v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) have emerged as a versatile approach for solving nonlinear partial differential equations (PDEs), yet achieving high accuracy efficiently using these techniques remains challenging for high-dimensional or multiscale systems. Here, we present a hybrid quantum-classical framework that enhances Quantum PINNs (QPINNs) through adaptive collocation point sampling and loss-aware attention mechanisms. By dynamically prioritizing points in regions with large PDE residuals or steep solution gradients, our method mitigates the spectral bias inherent in conventional PINNs. item.title: 用于全球跨传感器星载火山热活动识别的混合量子卷积神经网络
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Claudia Corradino, Federica Torrisi, Alessandro Grilli, Tommaso Catuogno, Mattia Verducci, Elisabetta Paladino, Luigi Giannelli, Alessandro Sebastianelli
该研究提出一种混合量子 AlexNet 架构，用于全球尺度跨传感器识别火山热活动。模型将经典卷积骨干网络与参数化量子电路相结合，通过高维 Hilbert 空间中的表征学习增强特征区分能力。实验结果表明，该混合量子模型相比经典模型在较少可训练参数和训练数据条件下具有更好的跨传感器迁移性和环境鲁棒性。

item.title: Physics-Informed Neural Networks for Complex Eigenfrequency Identification and Mode Structure Reconstruction of the Ground-State ITG Branch
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Dengdi Sun, Bingbing Zhang, Xiao Wang, Zikang Yan, Yuqiang Tao, Qingquan Yang, Guosheng Xu, Jin Tang

Localized high-frequency oscillations, strong real-imaginary coupling, and nonlinear coupling between the mode field and eigenfrequency challenge PINN representation and joint optimization. To address these challenges, we propose a physi…

item.title: 一种基于机器学习的全球热层密度预报模型
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Ruochen Wang, Xiaoli Bai
该研究提出 AETHER-P3，一种基于机器学习的全球热层密度预报模型，可利用 3 小时输入窗口给出最长 6 小时的多步预报，并提供预测不确定性。模型将热层密度预报表述为序列到序列回归任务，并结合经验密度模型、太阳与地磁驱动以及太阳风参数以提高物理一致性。独立卫星测试显示其在平静、中等和极端地磁条件下均保持较高预报能力，且不确定性校准良好。

item.title: 利用深度神经网络进行极化靶核磁共振测量
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Devin Seay, Ishara P. Fernando, Dustin Keller
本文首次将神经网络架构成功用于连续波核磁共振极化计量。针对固态动态极化靶中传统 Q 表相敏检测易受噪声、基线漂移和拟合系统误差影响的问题，作者利用机器学习进行信号提取和去噪。结果在多种真实模拟与实验条件下显著降低拟合不确定性，从而提升在线极化监测和离线分析精度。

item.title: Electromagnetic analysis of low dropout regulator circuit with small-signal stability characterization for inductive LC filters and transformers
item.description:
📚 Preprints
👤 Xi Liu, Wenxi, Ken Perlin
This work systematically evaluates the capability of generative large language models (LLMs), specifically GPT-4o, to support the full design, simulation, and optimization workflow of low-dropout (LDO) linear voltage regulators. The study covers four core design phases: pre-design specification mapping, transistor-level circuit topology generation, SPICE simulation guidance, and post-simulation performance fine-tuning, with an extended investigation into the integration of magnetic inductive components within the LDO signal path. GPT-4o autonomously proposes a single-stage differential-pair error amplifier architecture with thin-oxide MOS transistors, provides sizing guidance for the PMOS pass element, and recommends passive compensation networks to secure closed-loop stability. The LDO t…

item.title: MSPPP-Act：一种受光稳定激光染料启发的深度神经网络自适应激活函数
item.description:
📚 Preprints
👤 Mohana Attia
激活函数为人工神经网络引入非线性，但 ReLU、Sigmoid 等传统函数存在死亡 ReLU、梯度消失或适应性不足等问题。本文提出 MSPPP-Act，一种受高稳定性 MSPPP 查耳酮激光染料光物理性质启发的物理信息自适应激活函数。该函数将染料的放大自发辐射阈值和光学增益轮廓抽象为平滑可微形式，并通过可训练参数与稳定机制改善反向传播中的适应性和梯度流。

item.title: RamanPFN: learning from Raman spectral structure with a tabular foundation model
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Xingyu Pan, Huan Wang, Jinjia Guo, Zhenlin Zhao, Siming Dong, Jixi Lu
arXiv:2608.02157v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Raman spectroscopy enables non-destructive, label-free molecular characterization across materials science, biomedicine and process monitoring. Predictive Raman datasets often contain few labelled spectra and thousands of ordered wavenumbers, with informative variation within bands and across distant spectral regions. Latent-variable chemometrics accommodates collinear small-sample data but can obscure fine peak morphology, whereas deep spectral networks resolve this structure only after task-specific training. TabPFN avoids task-specific parameter fitting through pretrained in-context inference, but processes very wide inputs as feature-subsampled views that do not preserve joint visibility of related bands. We present RamanPFN, a spectral…

item.title: 以接近实验精度预测碳 1s 结合能的图神经网络
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Adam E. A. Fouda, Joshua Zhou, Rodrigo Ferreira, Patrick Phillips, Valay Agarawal, Bhavnesh Jangid, Jacob J. Wardzala, Rui Ding, Junhong Chen, Nicole Tebaldi, Phay J. Ho, Laura Gagliardi, Linda Young
本文提出用于预测有机分子中碳 1s 核电子结合能的图神经网络模型，并以多构型对密度泛函理论数据进行训练。模型在实验数据上的平均误差接近已有理论基准，并表现出向更大有机分子迁移的能力。研究还比较了等变图神经网络、旋转不变模型以及基于原子位置平滑重叠描述符的核岭回归模型，并展示了其对复杂分子快速分析的潜力。

item.title: Physics-informed neural networks for two-dimensional wall-reactive solute dispersion in canonical shear flows
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Nanda Poddar, Subham Dhar
arXiv:2608.00856v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The dispersion of reactive solutes in shear flows is governed by the interplay between advective stretching, transverse diffusion, and boundary exchange kinetics. While classical analytical methods and grid-based numerical solvers have extensively characterised these transport mechanisms, accurately resolving the spatiotemporal evolution of solute plumes in asymmetric reactive environments remains computationally demanding. In this study, we introduce a physics-informed neural network (PINN) framework to simulate two-dimensional wall-reactive solute dispersion in canonical shear flows (Couette, Poiseuille, and Couette-Poiseuille) bounded by absorbing walls. By embedding the governing convection-diffusion equation and Robin boundary condition…

👤 Xin Chen, Zhen Han, Linyang Li, Mingwen Zhao

item.title: Non-linear spin current in the surface states of topological insulators
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Srijan Chatterjee, Tarun Kanti Ghosh
arXiv:2608.01782v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Spin Hall effect is one of the primary sources of pure spin current in spintronic devices, observed in spin-orbit coupled materials. In this work, we investigate linear and non-linear pure spin currents in the hexagonally warped surface states of topological insulators like m̊ Bi₂Te₃, using the formalism of conserved spin transport. The hexagonal warping effect enables the application of this formalism by providing a well-defined Berry curvature without breaking the time-reversal symmetry. The absence of in-plane spin currents in the linear response motivates the extension of the formalism to the non-linear regime, by combining the perturbation of Bloch states with the Boltzmann transport equation. The second-order response exhibits both int…

item.title: 堆叠交替磁性 CrO 中扭转诱导的磁性拓扑相变
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Zi-Hao Ding, Ze-Feng Gao, Xiang-Hua Kong, Peng-Jie Guo, Zhong-Yi Lu
本文通过对称性分析和第一性原理计算表明，双层堆叠 CrO 的公度扭转可驱动磁性拓扑相变。该过程可将反铁磁狄拉克半金属转变为 d 波交替磁性双极化 Weyl 半金属或非常规补偿磁性 Weyl 半金属。研究指出，扭转保持关键自旋对称性，使 Weyl 相成为由扭转稳健诱导的结果，为扭转二维材料中的磁性拓扑相工程提供了对称性路径。

item.title: 磁斯格明子与光学斯格明子的相互作用
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Lan Bo, Jian Chen, Xichao Zhang, Yan Zhou, Chengwei Qiu, Masahito Mochizuki
本文研究单个磁斯格明子与光学斯格明子光束之间的相互作用，识别出旋转、跳跃和次摆线运动三种非线性动力学模式。作者将光学驱动力分解为梯度、轨道角动量和自旋角动量贡献，阐明其在径向束缚、方位漂移和进动调制中的作用。研究还指出三维传播中的差分 Gouy 相位会导致 z 方向不对称的跳跃轨迹，为光磁调控提供可按螺旋性选择和相位编程的途径。

item.title: 交替磁性α-MnTe中产生巨大反常霍尔电导的磁可调对称性强制节点线
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Mathews Benny, Xujia Gong, Amar Fakhredine, Raphaël Salazar, Ashutosh S. Wadge, Juraj Krempaský, Gunther Springholz, Sarath Sasi, Dawid Wutke, Rafał Kurleto, Natalia Olszowska, Sahar Izadi Vishkayi, Asiyeh Shokri, Ján Minár, Carmine Ortix, Jeroen van den Brink, Jakub Schusser, Carmine Autieri
本文阐明交替磁性α-MnTe中室温附近巨大反常霍尔电导的起源，指出其来自价带中两组由对称性保护的节点线。作者表明，这些位于kz=0和kz=π/c的节点线分别受镜面对称性和滑移对称性保护，并与弱铁磁性强烈耦合。小的自旋倾斜即可显著改变节点线和反常霍尔电导，使二者具备磁可调性，角分辨光电子能谱线二色性也显示出节点线迹象。

item.title: 少层CrSBr中磁有序的光学切换
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Lukas Husel, Julian Trapp, Moritz Würf, Anna Rupp, Tim Wedl, Kenji Watanabe, Takashi Taniguchi, Iva Plutnarova, Zdenek Sofer, Alexander Högele
本文研究二维范德华层状反铁磁体CrSBr中利用光操控磁性的机制。作者通过激子吸收和光致发光，在双层和三层CrSBr中展示了磁有序的光学切换，并在近临界外磁场下用微瓦级连续波激光实现局域和远程切换。该机制还可用于确定性制备零场磁构型，显示出磁光电子器件应用潜力。

item.title: Triple-Q 磁有序中的拓扑缺陷：固定晶格同伦分类
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Jin-Tao Jin, Yi Zhou
本文对 M 点 triple-Q Ginzburg–Landau 理论中 N=2 和 3 的七种稳定相的体缺陷进行固定晶格同伦分类。研究强调原子晶格被视为给定背景，需区分自由内部缺陷、晶体畴壁和束缚于畴壁的复合缺陷。结论修正了某些相空间流形与涡旋类型的认识，并说明平移对弹性项形式的限制。

item.title: 单层多铁材料中电磁振子的观测
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Mohammad Amini, Tiago V. C. Antão, Liwei Jing, Ziying Wang, Antti Karjasilta, Robert Drost, Shawulienu Kezilebieke, Jose L. Lado, Adolfo O. Fumega, Peter Liljeroth
该研究使用低温扫描隧道显微镜，在单层 NiI₂ 中实现了电磁振子的原子尺度观测。通过跟踪多铁相的热演化并结合第一性原理和自旋模型计算，作者确认低能带隙内激发源于电磁振子。空间分辨非弹性隧穿谱图显示出与理论预测一致的条纹状局域谱函数调制，为原子尺度探测多铁集体激发提供了方法。

item.title: 二维交替磁体中由 Néel 矢量取向诱导的方向稳健自旋过滤
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Xin Chen, Jin Zou, Lipeng Song, Wei Sun, Yiwen Wu, Luyao Zhu, Xu Cheng, Duo Wang, Biplab Sanyal
该研究提出了一种在补偿二维交替磁性 Weyl 半金属中实现无能隙、方向稳健自旋过滤的机制，不依赖传统自旋选择性带隙或巨大速度差异。以 Janus 单层 Ta₂TeSeO 为平台，作者结合对称性分析、第一性原理、Wannier 插值和半经典输运，说明 Néel 矢量旋转可重构 Weyl 锥并产生电导不平衡。结果显示在特定 Néel 矢量取向下，自旋过滤在所有面内电流方向上保持正极化，为补偿交替磁体中的可切换自旋过滤提供了通用路径。

item.title: 极性交替磁候选材料 Mn₂Mo₃O₈ 中太赫兹模式的磁圆二色性与拉曼活性光学声子的选择定则
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 F. Schilberth, K. Vasin, M. Knauft, M. Kondákor, M. Vuckovic, N. Herrmann, K. Penc, M. Minola, B. Keimer, V. A. Martinez, K. Panda, A. A. Sirenko, L. Prodan, V. Tsurkan, A. A. Tsirlin, I. Kézsmárki, J. Deisenhofer
本文利用温度依赖拉曼散射和磁光太赫兹时域透射光谱研究了共线交替磁候选材料 Mn₂Mo₃O₈ 的磁激发与振动激发。结合从头算计算，作者识别了全部光学声子并分析了顺磁相与磁有序相中的选择定则。研究未分辨出预期的 E₂ 声子圆偏振劈裂，但在磁有序态中观察到强磁圆二色性的宽太赫兹激发带。

item.title: 二维反铁磁体中由自旋手性驱动的非相对论 Edelstein 效应
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Hao Zuo, Xiaoyin Li, Jian Zhou
本文通过群论与第一性原理数值模拟相结合，指出矢量自旋手性可作为反铁磁体系中非相对论 Edelstein 响应的有效调控参数。研究还考察了电流诱导磁矩中的轨道角动量贡献，并揭示其与自旋贡献不同的对称性约束。结果提出了一条不依赖自旋轨道耦合而实现电控磁化的新路径。

item.title: 面心立方 Ba₂(Yb,Nd)NbO₆ 双钙钛矿中的自旋轨道纠缠受挫磁性
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 S. M. Hossain, Sk. Soyeb Ali, S. Mohanty, R. Kolay, M. P. Saravanan, A. K. Yogi, Y. Tokiwa, R. Nath, S. K. Panda, M. Majumder
本文研究了稀土双钙钛矿 Ba₂YbNbO₆ 和 Ba₂NdNbO₆，二者具有面心立方结构。磁化与热容测量表明，强自旋轨道耦合和晶体电场效应导致孤立的 jₑff=1/2 Kramers 双重态基态，并在毫开尔文温区出现具有中等受挫的长程磁有序。研究认为其磁有序可在含有限 Kitaev 相互作用的稀土 fcc 晶格的无序选序图景下理解。

item.title: Magnetic order and excitations in the magnetically intercalated van der Waals material Crfᵣₐc₁₄NbSe₂
item.description:

item.title: 交流场驱动的悬浮磁性纳米颗粒取向交叉与能量耗散

We propose and test a background-independent effective statistical model in which classi- cal spacetime geometry and Einstein gravity emerge from the coarse-grained connectivity of a confining flux-tube network. The microscopic substrate is a dynamical graph of integer-valued flux occupation variables on the links of a lattice, motivated by the confinement of non-Abelian gauge theories and the area-law behaviour of Wilson loops. We show that the network admits a percolation phase structure and that a block-link renormalization-group (RG) transformation flows the system to a nontrivial interacting fixed point at which a scale-invariant connectivity field ρ(x) emerges. item.title: Combining ultra-flexible electrodes with two-photon imaging to illuminate brain-wide neural dynamics
item.description:
📚 Preprints
👤 Christopher Lewis, Adrian Roggenbach, Linus Meienberg, Tansel Yasar, Peter Gombkoto, Wolfger von der Behrens 等9位作者
Brain activity consists of neural signals dynamically coordinated across spatial and temporal scales. To sample distributed brain-wide activity, we combine chronically implanted ultra-flexible electrodes for subcortical recordings with simultaneous two-photon calcium imaging in mouse neocortex. Flexible electrodes preserve optical access even at steep insertion angles and enable weeks-long single-neuron tracking. With these combined recordings, we demonstrate how subcortical-cortical coupling is modulated across slow brain states and around fast ripple events.
